findings.description: In wordLadder(), the loop indexes strcomp[i] up to word.length() without verifying strcomp is at least that long.
The code does not validate that the start/target words have the same length as each other or as dictionary words before character-by-character comparisons.
The code does not check whether the input file was successfully opened or whether formatted reads succeeded.
Depth-first recursive search on untrusted input size can lead to stack exhaustion (potential denial of service).
No constraint on extremely large inputs can lead to excessive resource consumption.
